summary_en: FANUC authorized the repurchase of up to 10 million shares (1.08% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 26, 2026 to April 30, 2027, to ensure flexibility and agility in capital allocation amid changing business conditions.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 23, 2026, FANUC's Board of Directors resolved to acquire up to 10 million shares of its own common stock for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from October 26, 2026 to April 30, 2027. The maximum number of shares represents 1.08% of outstanding shares, calculated from the 924.9 million shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026.

The company stated that the purpose of this repurchase is to respond to changes in the business environment and to ensure flexibility and agility in capital allocation strategy. This authorization does not specify an upper price limit for individual purchases but sets an aggregate monetary ceiling of 5.0 billion yen.
